repository_intelligence.purpose: Curated index of public DESIGN.md files and website design-system examples for browsing visual identity patterns.
repository_intelligence.reuse_recommendation: Use as a research index and inspect source-site rights before copying tokens, branding or visual assets.
repository_intelligence.inspection_scope: Pinned README and package overview reviewed; repository summary rather than exhaustive internal asset decomposition.
repository_intelligence.license_notes: Review repository license and the independent rights of linked design assets.
risk_notes: Linked designs remain owned by their respective authors; catalogue inclusion does not grant reuse rights.
